Icelandic original: „Heimabærinn minn, mér finnst fólkið í bænum skemmtilegt og yndislegt fólk. Við erum með duglegt og kraftmikið íþróttafólk, listrænt og hæfileikaríkt leiklistar fólk, sterka og vinnusama iðnaðarmenn og margt fleira sem heldur bænum uppi og ýtir okkur áfram að betra samfélagi.“
English gloss: “My hometown, I think the people in town are fun and lovely people. We have hardworking and energetic athletes, artistic and talented theater people, strong and hardworking tradespeople, and much more that keeps the town going and pushes us toward a better society.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
